items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the two functors on presheaves attached to a functor of categories are adjoint, that is, that the displayed bijection of morphism sets holds bifunctorially (statement lines 783-793). The proof is a complete construction of the two maps: one is obtained by composing with the unit supplied by a companion result (proof lines 803-808), the other by applying the first functor and composing with a canonical map from the values of the composite, whose functoriality is noted to be immediate (proof lines 811-824). The non-formal content is the construction of the two maps; the author explicitly leaves to the reader only the verification that they are inverse to each other (proof lines 799-800). The claim is H1/H2: a short construction in both directions with the routine verification noted.
